create_ModuleProxyWrapper: create a ModuleProxyWrapper to wrap a DistributedDataParallel module and forward attribute access to the twice-wrapped module
use___getattr__: use the __getattr__ method to forward missing attribute requests through the DDP wrapper to the underlying module
call_state_dict: call state_dict on a ModuleProxyWrapper to retrieve the state dictionary from the twice-wrapped module
call_load_state_dict: call load_state_dict on a ModuleProxyWrapper to load model state into the twice-wrapped module
call_forward: call forward on a ModuleProxyWrapper to delegate the forward pass through the DDP-wrapped module
